    - Fix for Flashback not correctly spawning Wraiths. Improved visuals to make this card's effect more obvious before it immediately banishes.
    - Fix for Quarterstaff and other cards that could move targets to empty positions causing a soft lock on the Beta branch
    - Fix for Cleaver and Throwing Axe sprites being assigned to the wrong Asset Bundle.

    - Fix for various typos in French translations.
    - Fix for Septic Blade appearing blank under some circumstances.

notes.title: [1.1.19] - Patch
notes.notes:
[b][Changes][/b]
    - Endris no longer spawns a Hidden Strike for a random party member if his attack was evaded, or blocked by a barricade. Now the entire intent is evaded, and no card is spawned.
    - Quarterstaff now deals 8 damage.
    - Oaths and Modifiers that affect damage-output are now run before character statuses and passives. This also fixes the Juggernaut passive being run after the Heathens Oath, blocking damage from ruin cards that should have exceeded its damage threshold.
    - Charge now applies to Shrapnel's first hit, including it as part of the multi-attack.

[b][Fixes][/b]
    - Fix for being unable to select lower option buttons with a controller in Scenarios under certain circumstances due to unmet criteria.
    - Fix for lack of proper localisation on card-selection-choices during scenarios.
    - Fix for Practiced not triggering the Ender Crossbowmen's Overwatch effect.
    - Fix for Quarterstaff only allowing you to move a target to a vacant position, and not swap two targets.
    - Fix for Reckless Cleave allowing you to select a Ruin card to "ruin again".
    - Fix for Refresh being considered as only a single Banish by passives such as Vindictive.
    - Fix for Gladius' Warrior's Stance status being able to be increased beyond 4 if dealt excess damage from Dominion. Warrior's stance now explicitly checks for attacks from player characters, and not any statuses or passives they own.
    - Fix for Sharp triggering before Assassin, causing it to increase its stack even when spawning Poisoned Blades.
    - Fix for some ordering of how statuses and passives are run, involving Carapace, Spearman's Defence and Retaliate.
    - Fix for TheLeague scenario offering the same Weapon more than once when opting for the tailored service.
    - Fix for the Pray scenario being incorrectly assigned the Altar artwork for its Scenario, meaning it could display white after failing to load in some situations. 
    - Fix for missing controller selection indicator and tooltip on the Smithy's Apprentice Trade Window.
    - Fix for Taking Cover still blocking players from targeting opponents, after destroying a barricade as part of a Swap interaction. (E.g. using Control to land the killing blow and then selecting a new lane in front of Spitter.)

notes.title: [1.0.18] First Patch - Informant updates!
notes.notes:
[h1][b][1.0.18][/b] - Patch[/h1]

Firstly, thanks to everyone for playing! The response has been quite overwhelming, and brought a welcome burst of enthusiasm to the playerbase.

We've been listening to all your feedback since our launch into full release, and this patch aims to address much of that.

[h2]Informant Escape Scenario[/h2]
One thing that became clear was that our intent for the design of the new Informant Escape scenario was not being well communicated, causing some frustration among players. This, along with many fixes, is the focus of this update.

The Escape scenario was meant to test your card draw, however it became clear that the fight was insufficiently difficult, meaning if you lacked the necessary draw, you would enter into a long and drawn out fight that could even lead to an impossible stalemate. This obviously isn't how we want any combat in the game to play out, so we've made some changes!

The gate no longer ticks down, and you will start with 2x Chains by default. To offset this decrease in difficulty, it must now be raised to 15, the combat will begin with opponent barricades, and up to 3 Ender Guardians will take their place when they are destroyed. New enemies will spawn after this, but [b]only whilst the gate is below the threshold value of 15[/b], after which they will stop spawning, and the fight will work like any regular combat.

We had some other design changes in mind for this fight, but we wanted to address the immediate issues and alleviate the frustration for now. This probably won't be the last tweak we make to that combat, and we'll continue to listen to feedback about whether we need to increase its difficulty further, or make other adjustments.

[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]
Feedback concerning certain Quality of Life features also hasn't gone unnoticed! Some of these issues require changes that aren't as simple as they seem, so haven't made it into this update, but rest assured, we've heard you! Improvements in this area are planned and on their way.

For those playing on controllers, we're also hoping to bring some of the improvements we're currently making to the Switch build over to the PC version in the coming weeks.

Overall, we hope you enjoy the update!


[h2]Full release notes below[/h2]

[h3][Changes][/h3]
- Characters no longer show "The Hammer" underneath their surname.
- Recruitable characters will no longer spawn with Heavy armour unless their Stamina is greater than or equal to 4.
- Spitter and his Gang Bruisers now have reduced Max Vitality.
- Barricades in the fight with Spitter now start with 20 Defence.
- The Informant Escape scenario (sewer gate combat) now behaves differently. The gate no longer ticks down, and you will start with 2x Chains by default. To offset this decrease in difficulty, it must now be raised to 15, the combat will begin with opponent barricades, and up to 3 Ender Guardians will take their place when they are destroyed. However, new enemies will only spawn whilst the gate is below the threshold value of 15.
- Removing an upgraded card from your deck will now automatically store the token in your token book, avoiding the need to do it by hand.

[h3][Fixes][/h3]
- Fix for three Hare talents (Pivot, PlanOfAttack and Urgency) spawning as Skills. [b]This does mean loading a run with these cards will load them with a dead wielder, so they will be removed from your deck after your next combat.[/b]
- Fix for Spymaster TrueStrike intent causing a softlock if the Spymaster is targeting the character in front of the shadow, and they evade the Shadow's attack
- Fix for the bonus campaign cards being added to the beginning of the run before they would have been unlocked by the player.
- Fix for statuses still alternating the turns on which they tick in "that" fight.
- Subtle fix / change for Zealot, where it will now trigger if the character with Zealot has a status effecting them that banishes cards (e.g. Exertion).
- Fix for Grave passive not triggering if your banish pile reaches 12 by cards banishes that happen during cleanup (stashed weapons, or cards with dead wielders). Cleanup may now also trigger any other similar banish related effects.
- Fix for Akimbo consuming Charge prematurely when dual wielding, and therefore not working with the Mouse Racial Ability correctly.
- Fix for a lockup in the second combat tutorial if you chose a card that already appears in your deck (e.g. Rush) as a reward for the first combat.
- Fix for statuses still alternating their effects based on rank, even when both ranks are active
- Fix for input bug that would cause the opening Informant card to be selected along with Forgotten Tunnel, meaning after the first combat, you would return to find the Informant card missing.
- Fix for screen prompts (shown by campaign cards that require selecting a lane) being left on-screen when exiting to the main menu.
- Fix for being locked out of the tutorial if you quit to the main menu before the "Party Screen" prompt.
- Fix for Provoked blocking Beavers from selecting their barricades (e.g. using Craftsman)
- Fix for Greataxe not dealing additional adjacent damage if the target had a status/passive that gave them more defence when their defence was broken (e.g. The Warden).
- Fix for preselecting a talent allowing for that talent to appear twice in the final selection.
- Fix for HiddenStrike intent setting the spawned card's wielder to a null character (appearing dead) when targeting barricades. HiddenStrikes targeting barricades will now set the wielder to a random party member.
- Fix for cards with special per-instance values (e.g. Oathkeeper) displaying "PARSE_FAILED" when they were obtained by re-rolling or transforming.
- Fix for being able to hover campaign cards over certain hot spots when viewing the party screen.
- Fix for an issue where defeating The Warden in a run from an older version of the game could move to the Unlocks Screen without awarding XP, and without deleting the save game. Players who have encountered this can now Continue their campaign, and should now be awarded appropriate XP for the run.
- Fix for Akimbo working inconsistently with weapon-handing.
- Fix for RecklessCleave only dealing a base damage of 15
- Fix for Charge not being consumed correctly with certain cards, e.g. DancingBlades
- Fix for a soft-locking exception under very specific circumstances, for intent-dependent cards/passives (e.g. Battleaxe).


Bug report info here: [url=https://www.montebearo.co.uk/bor-bug-report/]https://www.montebearo.co.uk/bor-bug-report/[/url]

notes.title: Banners of Ruin - Full Release!
notes.notes:
[h3]We're in the end game now![/h3]

On the 30th of July last year, we launched into Early Access - we're super excited to launch into our full release just a day shy of one year later!

Banners of Ruin has changed [b]a lot[/b] since its initial launch, and we'd like to thank all of our players - and most especially our Beta Testers + Supporters - for their feedback and encouragement. It wouldn't be the same game without you! 

[h3]Here's the highlights of everything that's been added since the Early Access release:[/h3]
[list]
[*] A whole new progression system for unlocking new characters and cards.
[*] Each race now has its own unique ability that fundamentally changes gameplay.
[*] An entirely new End Game, which you can access by completing the three "Informant Tasks" in each street. This changes the course of your run, and unlocks the final 2 bosses of the game! (More on this below).
[*] Card Upgrade Tokens, which apply additional effects after playing a card.
[*] End of Street Elite variants and several new enemies.
[*] So much new art! We even got a fancy cutscene in there! 
[*] The Stash system, so you can hold onto Weapons and Armour for later use, and swap at any time.
[*] Over 20 new Scenarios, including some that let you recruit new characters, take on missions, or let you swap equipment at the start of a run.
[*] Oaths! These difficulty modifiers will earn you more XP in each run, and also drastically impact gameplay.
[*] Full Controller Support!
[*] A total of over 300 cards and Passives, and a Compendium to view them all! 
[/list]
On top of that, we're also excited to launch on Nintendo Switch, so you can play on the go!

It's been a long road, and the last couple of months have been pretty stressful - but ultimately we're pretty proud of what our first game has grown into, and the community that's grown around it. We'd like to thank our friends, family, and the wonderful folks at Goblinz for all their help on this strange little journey.

[h3]With that out of the way - let's check out what's new in this update![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37646280/36cc6946e9dbc7998d29d045de510451203316e5.png[/img]

Spitter is a new End of Street Elite variant for the first street - which we're now calling "The Outer Districts".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37646280/fd0f698004172cea8b8be7446259915ccaaa066d.gif[/img]

He's a dastardly little mouse with a few tricks up his sleeve. He's got some potent attacks,  and likes to hide behind cover! Watch out for him and his gang in The Outer Districts!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37646280/c11ff82ee917c3ac1bad5574ea0029be8634d9d5.png[/img]

After you beat the Warden, you will now unlock [b]The Informant[/b]. He has a task for you to complete in each street. Succeed in all three, and he'll find you a way into the Inner Keep of Dawn's Point, to fight the last line of the Ender defence. Be prepared for some tough fights along the way, and a need to adapt your playstyle to overcome unique challenges. Make sure to keep an eye out for each task as you make your way through the streets and pay attention to each task's objective - skipping any will forfeit the end game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37646280/ced41913f28ff0eac6305a4066a39c425d0f77f8.jpg[/img]

[h3]Endgame Bosses[/h3]

Once you've completed each Informant Task, and beat the Warden to gain access to the Keep, you'll enter The End Game. There's [b]two new bosses[/b] here that we don't want to spoil - but it's safe to say they each have some mechanics that are radically different to anything we've added to the game before. 

Completing the end game also unlocks a set of unique openings to the campaign, that will widen your deckbuilding options across future runs.

You may find the last bosses to be a really tough challenge, but we're sure you can do it. Keep your wits about you, bring your best builds - and [b]finish the fight[/b].

[i]This update also adjusts the balance of the meta progression - levelling each race was looking like more of a grind than we wanted, so we've lowered the XP thresholds of their unlocks. As a result, you may find after your next run you've unlocked a bunch of stuff, even for races who weren't in your party. Additionally, in an ongoing run, you may be offered Talents / Passives that are then shown as Unlocked when you end the campaign. This is to be expected, as the game will consider those items unlocked but hasn't displayed a notification to you yet - it shouldn't cause any later issues.[/i]

Thanks again to those who have supported the game over the course of Early Access - we hope you've enjoyed your time with the game, and continue to do so! For now, we're off to have a cup of tea!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37646280/88515767c3e48c22f03e3cfff66c797a81f601b4.jpg[/img]

[h2]Feedback / Bugs[/h2]

With each update, we encourage you to discuss new features alongside your fellow players, either here on the steam forums, or in our discord: https://discord.gg/HXdVQHb. The discord has dedicated channels for submitting feedback and bugs, as well as a very helpful and active community. If you're a Supporter, there's also a private channel you can check out to find out how to access the private Supporter beta.

[h3]Once again, thank you![/h3]

notes.title: Archetypes Milestone Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We've been extremely busy working on an update that addresses loads of your feedback, makes some landmark improvements we've been planning for a long time, and adds tons of new features!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37646280/f9f8de8d4f96ced3e3967bb94ad06efc7f979dfc.gif[/img]

[h2]The Archetypes Milestone Update![/h2]

[h3]Race Abilities[/h3] This one's been in the making for a long time, and addresses a point of feedback we've been eager to develop since our initial launch; making each race distinct. [b]Each race now has a special ability[/b] completely unique to its class, ranging from spawning cards, to placing traps, to building barricades. These cost a point of Will to use, and you can check them all out from:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37646280/7bcdfeff3018698c764a20957ce1780e4e437e0b.png[/img]

[h3]The New Unlock Screen![/h3] The previous unlock shop was always intended to be placeholder, and it's finally time to bring in the overhauled system:

Races are now unlocked sequentially, improving the progression and avoiding overwhelming new players. Whenever your campaign comes to an end, win or lose, you'll be awarded XP, just like before. However now, each level will automatically unlock a new Race, set of cards or feature in-game. You can start a new campaign with any races you've unlocked, but you'll also be able to find [b]the next race you're due to unlock ready to recruit in Taverns.[/b] 

In addition to a unique pool of race-specific Talents and passives, each Race now has an additional [b]6 Talents and 3 Passives[/b] that will be gradually unlocked as you play with those characters. [b]Every time you level up a character[/b] in a campaign, you'll earn XP [i]specific to that Race[/i], and at every Tier, you'll unlock a new Talent or Passive for their class.

[hr][/hr]Don't worry - if you're a veteran player, you'll maintain your progress, and will likely have most or all of the races unlocked, it's just their unlockable Talents and Passives you won't have, as this relies on new save data. [i]Just be sure to check out the Unlocks screen before starting a new run - you'll be bombarded with unlocks![/i]
[hr][/hr]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37646280/47caa1e782033dee7caab8d51ad906f2590671af.gif[/img]

[h3]Endgame Cutscene[/h3] We're extremely excited to share this! It's been a huge effort from the whole team, and we really think it adds some great payoff for completing a run - we hope you'll agree!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37646280/4d4d944d6834a3edf68267726b6880d858450f0e.gif[/img]

[h3]Gritsalt[/h3] There's a new End of Street Elite on the loose, the infamous Seagard Captain, [b]Gritsalt[/b]. Watch out for him on the second street, he has a few tricks up his sleeves! We've also made some changes and added some new variants for existing enemies, so look out for those too!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37646280/4f11ed403fb09bf19dbdd528ec96454f989708d8.gif[/img]

[h3]Card Upgrade Tokens[/h3] Once you're a few levels in, you'll now start seeing some new scenarios which award a variety of [b]Card Upgrade Tokens[/b]. You can assign these to any card, triggering various effects after you play them, such as healing, applying statuses, or even modifying the cost of the card. [b]You're free to rearrange these at any time outside of combat[/b], from the Party Screen. Expect to see more in the way of Card Upgrades in future updates!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37646280/1b402c7264c12386ba869d6efcf4cc2c94db2917.jpg[/img]

[h3]Opening Variety[/h3] After your first run, you'll start to see new Scenario cards [b]before you enter the first street[/b]. These will offer a variety of things, from a choice of starter weapons, cards, upgrades, and other juicy bonuses!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37646280/41af31665e13899ee309a7a7464d43b1ad9d6d1d.jpg[/img]

[h3]New Backgrounds and Scenarios[/h3] Every street in the campaign now has its own feel, with a [b]unique backdrop and set of combat backgrounds[/b]. There's also a few new scenarios ready to encounter, and some additional choices in existing ones!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37646280/3458beec19fc4459e8c12dd333ba6f46b80e90e9.jpg[/img]

[h3]Card and Passive Updates[/h3] On top of all this, you'll see some huge changes and some new additions to cards and passives in general. We've improved many underwhelming cards, and done a balancing pass on several others. You'll notice some big adjustments to [b]Will and Banishing[/b], along with the ability to modify a card's cost - among other changes!

[i]The tutorial has also been given a slight rework, now explaining how to evade lane attacks, as well as how to use the new race abilities, so you may want to check that out too![/i]

[hr][/hr][b]Note:[/b] Some cards that were Talents are now Skills, and vice versa - this may affect your run. If you're really happy with a build you have going, we'd recommend either finishing your campaign before updating, or starting afresh with a new one.[i][/i][hr][/hr]
[h3]Release notes[/h3]
Since the last update, there have been [b]over 100 changes and fixes[/b]. If you want to check out the full release notes, you can find them here: https://www.montebearo.co.uk/bor-release-notes

[h2]Feedback / Bugs[/h2]

With each update, we encourage you to discuss new features alongside your fellow players, either here on the steam forums, or in our discord: https://discord.gg/HXdVQHb. The discord has dedicated channels for submitting feedback and bugs, as well as a very helpful and active community. If you're a Supporter, there's also a private channel you can check out to find out how to access the private Supporter beta.

[h3]Once again, thank you![/h3]

[hr][/hr][strike]Localisation: Currently the new content and changes are only supported in the following languages, but we hope to release a patch with the remaining languages shortly[/strike].

All localisations are now up to date!

[b]Supported Languages: English, French, German, Polish, Portuguese (Brazilian), Spanish, Russian, Chinese (Simplified) and Japanese.[/b][/i]

notes.title: Scenario Milestone Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We've been working hard over the last few weeks on lots of new content! We've continued to listen to your feedback, and this update adds some much-requested features!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37646280/a878b584d07f04f15ebd33fdd4a9f11802b79be5.gif[/img]

[h2]The Scenarios Milestone Update![/h2]

[h3]15 new scenarios![/h3] We've had a lot of fun writing many, many new scenarios! These offer lots of new features, but the main highlight is [b]you can now hire characters outside of the tavern[/b]. Several of the new scenarios, such as [i]Convict[/i], will let you enlist new characters! The Hire screen has also had a major facelift, check it out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37646280/21facc897d3091bfb628fbd39548677ff45893db.gif[/img]

[h3]3 new enemies![/h3] Introducing the [b]Patterford Goldknot[/b], the [b]Ender Guardian[/b] and the [b]Smuggling Gang[/b] (which has 2 individual new units). You can find these opponents in the later streets, and in one of the new scenarios. They should offer some additional challenge!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37646280/9f1a6bf58ac441f1f72009c0b9636ee3acc99903.gif[/img]

[h3]Stashed Equipment[/h3] We listened closely to your feedback on equipment, and made some major changes to improve the overall experience. Firstly, introducing: [i]The Stash[/i]. [b]You can now store weapons and armour for future use[/b]. Now you don't have to pass up on good gear if you're planning on hiring a new character. You only get 2 stash slots though, so think carefully about what you want to take with you! Stashed weapons will take up space in your deck, but they behave similarly to dead character cards in combat, being banished from your hand at the end of your turn. 

Additionally, you can now also [b]swap equipment between party members[/b] at any time, from the party screen. Put that crossbow on the wrong guy? No problem!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37646280/473af472520d6cc48dabb05db1654c3269a60be9.gif[/img]

[h3]New Scenario Features[/h3] As mentioned above, you can now hire characters in scenarios, but the new features don't stop there. Scenarios can now have random outcomes for extra variety, let you trade stashed items, or even take on some work for extra coin. Other scenarios apply modifiers whose effects can last for the duration of your campaign. You can think of these like Passives for your whole Party!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37646280/fe0ac56b55553c7adea838fe29827e9e63d00aca.gif[/img]

[h3]Tools of the Trade[/h3] As a team, we really enjoyed the response to the "Voices in the Dark" scenario when we first added it; players loved getting a new weapon that mirrored the abilities of their enemy. We were always eager to add more of these, and we're happy to say there are a couple of new such additions in this update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37646280/fba71289505d6153f9799994e829161b69b27f94.jpg[/img]

[h3]UI Improvements[/h3] We made some massive improvements to the UI for this update, including entirely reworking the Scenario and Equipment UI from scratch. Scenarios now offer tooltips where appropriate, indicate combats, rewards and character-specific consequences more effectively. The party screen has also had a facelift, and should display information much more clearly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37646280/a2bd7bf06fd23c37c1238e49bc4913982111a361.jpg[/img]

[h3]Release notes[/h3]
Since the last update, there have been [b]over 30 changes and fixes[/b]. If you want to check out the full release notes, you can find them here: https://www.montebearo.co.uk/bor-release-notes

[h2]Feedback / Bugs[/h2]

With each update, we encourage you to discuss new features alongside your fellow players, either here on the steam forums, or in our discord: https://discord.gg/HXdVQHb. The discord has dedicated channels for submitting feedback and bugs, as well as a very helpful and active community. If you're a Supporter, there's also a private channel you can check out to find out how to access the private Supporter beta.

[h3]Once again, thank you![/h3]


[i]* Unfortunately there has been a short delay on the localisation for Japanese. We hope to get the translations for this new content very soon, our apologies for the delay.[/i]

notes.title: Oaths Milestone Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We've been listening closely to your feedback and working hard to bring you new content and features!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37646280/738e442710339742b73068c27b31bf4d0c7d38c3.gif[/img]

[h2]The Oaths Milestone Update![/h2]

[h3]Over 50 new cards![/h3] Instinct, Distraction, Heroic Strike, Hunter, Conviction, Deadly Harvest, Precision, Bless -- there's too many to name here! [b]Check out the release notes below for a full list![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37646280/da55e32395f3ffa745dc416804cf6b08754cfcf7.jpg[/img]

[h3]3 new enemy units![/h3] Introducing the [b]Ender Bannerman[/b], the [b]Seagard Trappers[/b] and the [b]Valenfax Stalkers[/b]. These new opponents offer some exciting new mechanics that should add a real challenge in the later streets!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37646280/1b136fb8d0cf21d6f1ef18999dbaed7c6b82e35d.gif[/img]

[h3]Compendium[/h3] From the main menu, you can now view a Compendium of all the cards and passives you've seen in the game, and filter them by type, race and cost. This should help you think about potential builds and synergies between various mechanics. Gotta catch 'em all!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37646280/498cefb68fd640ee7a009ce198204ff00765a5f6.jpg[/img]

[h3]Party Configuration[/h3] Gone is the little dropdown for picking your pair of starter characters! Now, when you begin a new run, you are able to select any pairing of races to start with, or even start with just 1 character! Your first character will start with Medium Armour, wielding an Hatchet and Round Shield, and the second wearing Light Armour and wielding a Longsword.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37646280/d02e2c879b93877e09a9b82b1714b0af555c0521.png[/img]

[h3]Oaths[/h3] If you're seeking an even harder challenge, look no further! Once you beat the game for the first time (from this update onwards), you will unlock [b]Oaths[/b]. These are modifiers you can set at the start of a new campaign, that last its entire duration, to increase difficulty in special ways and increase your final run's score. These range from increasing enemy damage, to suffering additional statuses, or losing gold from certain campaign encounters. You may select up to 3 Oaths, and many of them have 3 tiers that scale in difficulty (tiers are coming ahead of schedule on the roadmap, with more Oaths coming later instead).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37646280/1bf71f40797e10126820a84c4b04e3405aef5108.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Quality of Life Update
notes.notes:
Firstly, thanks to all of you for playing! The response so far has been overwhelming, and we'd like to thank everybody in the community for participating - be it sharing the game, streaming, being active in the discord or forums, or even taking the time to write a guide to help other players!

[h3]This first update addresses some of the biggest QoL issues and frustrations found in the game, including:[/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]Card cancelling![/b] Cards which target characters can now be cancelled with Right Click when in the targeting state. Cards which don't require targets (e.g. Guard) have a confirmation state, where they can be cancelled until you click them, but if you prefer the speed of single clicks, you can turn this off in Settings, under Gameplay/Card Confirmation.

[*] [b]Speed options![/b] Many of you reported that once you were comfortable with how the game worked, you found certain interactions took a while to resolve (looking at you, Clippers!). We heard you, and there are now 5 speed modes from Very Slow to Very Fast. These change the speed of combat, but playing on Fast or Very Fast will also make some campaign-screen animations faster too.

[*] [b]Your deck and party are now always accessible[/b] during scenarios and level ups, meaning you can review your setup at any time.

[*] [b]Character screen controls[/b] (cycling characters / Exit) are now usable with the mouse only!

[*] [b]Passives now indicate if they are exclusive to a race.[/b] These were always here, but now it's obvious! (These will be expanded throughout Early Access).

[*] [b]Steam Achievements[/b] should now unlock for everybody.
[/list]

Since launch, there have been [b]over 75 changes and fixes![/b] If you want to view the full release notes, including some card adjustments, you can view them here: 
https://www.montebearo.co.uk/bor-release-notes/

[h2]Where do we go from here?[/h2]

This update was designed to alleviate some of the most common issues and frustrations users encountered whilst playing the game. From here on out, we'll be focusing our attention on adding new content, including new cards, enemies, events and gameplay features. Throughout this period we'll also be constantly adjusting and tuning the game to help balance. We'll be sharing a roadmap soon for an overview of the timeline for these features, so stay tuned!

[h3]Beta Branch[/h3]

Adding new content involves several steps, and a lot of testing. Because of this, we'll be using steam's Beta branches to roll out new features on a regular basis until we hit milestones. If you want to see all the new content as soon as it becomes available, and don't mind some bugs / teething issues, this next section's for you! 

[b]Starting in a little over a week, two Beta branches will become available:[/b] 
[list]
[*] The first will be a private beta branch for all of our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1359660/Banners_of_Ruin__Supporter_Pack/]Supporters[/url]. Whenever we finish an initial pass on content, a bleeding-edge build will be uploaded to this branch for people to get a sneak preview of what's coming next, and help us test it out. 

[*] Around a week after this, that content will go live on a public beta branch, where everybody can opt into it.
[/list]

[b]This cycle will run for a few weeks until we hit a milestone, at which point the new content will go live on the default branch for everybody, as a stable release.[/b] 

The beta branches will only be fully supported in English, so that localisation passes can be done with each milestone release. If the beta sounds up your street - you can already opt into it! That way you'll be up to date as soon as a build goes live. 

To opt into the beta, right-click Banners of Ruin in your Steam library, select Properties, then the BETAs tab, and choose the beta branch from the dropdown.

[h2]Feedback / Bugs[/h2]

With each update, we encourage you to discuss new features alongside your fellow players, either here on the steam forums, or in our discord: https://discord.gg/HXdVQHb. The discord has dedicated channels for submitting feedback and bugs, as well as a very helpful and active community. If you're a Supporter, there's also a private channel you can check out to find out how to access the private Supporter beta.

[h3]Once again, thank you![/h3]

We're incredibly excited to take Banners of Ruin forward and expand it into our full vision for the game. We've got plenty in store to add over the coming weeks, and we hope you'll enjoy playing it!
